name: prompt-1071
image_vibe: Playfully annoyed pink-studio portrait with direct wide-angle interaction
image_purpose: Create a social-style portrait edit while preserving the approved adult subject's identity and styling.

prompt.project_info: A photorealistic edit using the required approved-adult person reference, changing only expression, pose, and background.
prompt.main_subject: The adult person from the required approved-adult reference photo. Keep the same face, facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, outfit, accessories, gender presentation, and overall likeness unchanged. Give the subject pouty lips and furrowed brows with a playful annoyed expression, as if saying 'stop filming me'.
prompt.composition_elements: Close wide-angle perspective with the body leaning slightly forward, one hand reaching toward the lens as if blocking a phone camera, a large foreground hand occupying approximately 30-50% of the frame with five natural fingers, face sharply focused behind the hand, and a clean solid pink studio backdrop.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Even clean studio lighting on the face and hand, soft pink background atmosphere, playful candid phone-camera interaction, and realistic skin and hand texture.
prompt.technical_specs: 18-28mm wide-angle perspective with mild foreground exaggeration, sharp face focus, photorealistic edit, natural hand anatomy, high-resolution clarity, no text, watermark, frame, or extra fingers.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic edit using the required approved-adult person reference photo. Keep the same face, facial features, skin tone, hairstyle including color, bangs, length, and volume, outfit, accessories, gender presentation, and overall likeness unchanged; do not face-swap or create a new person. Change only the expression, pose, and background: give the subject pouty lips and furrowed brows with a slightly annoyed but playful expression, as if saying 'stop filming me'. Use a close 18-28mm wide-angle perspective, lean the body slightly forward, and reach one hand toward the lens as if blocking a phone camera. Let the large foreground hand occupy 30-50% of the frame with five natural fingers and realistic anatomy while keeping the face sharply focused behind it. Replace the background with a clean solid pink seamless studio backdrop. Use clean even lighting, realistic skin and hand texture, no text, watermark, frame, extra fingers, deformed hands, or heavy blur.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, identity drift, face swap, new person, changed outfit, extra fingers, deformed hand, heavy blur, plastic skin, text, watermark, frame

assets.name: approved adult identity and styling reference
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult subject's face, facial features, skin tone, hairstyle, outfit, accessories, gender presentation, and overall likeness exactly while changing only expression, pose, and background.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the approved adult reference. Keep identity, outfit, accessories, and hairstyle unchanged; only the playful annoyed expression, blocking-hand pose, camera perspective, and pink seamless background may change.
